name: Lydia
summary: A seller of purple from the city of Thyatira who worshipped God. In Philippi the Lord opened her heart to Paul's message, and she was baptized with her household and opened her home to Paul and his companions.

key_moments.title: A Heart Opened by the Lord
key_moments.description: At a place of prayer by a river outside Philippi, Lydia heard Paul speak, and the Lord opened her heart to his words. She and her household were baptized, and she urged Paul's company to stay at her house.

key_moments.title: Welcome After Prison
key_moments.description: When Paul and Silas were released from prison, they went to Lydia's house. There they saw the believers, encouraged them, and then left the city.
